commands.name: key:generate
commands.description: generate the 32-byte APP_KEY

commands.name: serve
commands.usage: aru serve [-- flags for the application]
commands.description: build the views and run the application, once, without watching

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: apply the migrations collected from the registered modules

commands.name: migrate:rollback
commands.description: undo the last batch of migrations

commands.name: migrate:status
commands.description: show which migrations ran, and in which batch

commands.name: migrate:fresh
commands.description: roll everything back and migrate again (development only)

commands.name: schedule:list
commands.description: list the scheduled tasks, with the next run of each

commands.name: schedule:run
commands.description: run one scheduled task now, on the same path the scheduler uses

commands.name: queue:work
commands.description: drain a job queue; the same image with another argument

commands.name: queue:listen
commands.description: drain a queue in a child process, restarted after each job

commands.name: queue:restart
commands.description: ask every running worker to stop after its current job

commands.name: queue:pause
commands.description: stop workers taking jobs off a queue, without stopping them

commands.name: queue:resume
commands.description: let workers take jobs off a paused queue again

commands.name: queue:clear
commands.description: delete every job waiting on a queue, after confirming

commands.name: queue:monitor
commands.description: report how many jobs are waiting on each queue named

commands.name: queue:failed
commands.description: list the jobs that gave up, with why each one did

commands.name: queue:retry
commands.description: put failed jobs back in line, by id or by queue

commands.name: queue:forget
commands.description: delete one failed job

commands.name: queue:flush
commands.description: delete the failed jobs, keeping the recent ones

commands.name: queue:prune-failed
commands.description: delete the failed jobs past the retention, on a schedule

commands.name: queue:retry-batch
commands.description: put the failed jobs of one batch back in line

commands.name: queue:prune-batches
commands.description: delete the stale rows from the batch list

commands.name: build
commands.description: compile one static binary, with its checksum, or a container image

commands.name: native:run
commands.description: build the native application and open its window

commands.name: native:dev
commands.description: rebuild the native application and reopen it on every change

commands.name: native:build
commands.usage: aru native:build [-target os/arch] [-output path] [-name text] [-appid id] [-version 1.0.0.1] [-icon icon.png] [-package] [-signkey path] [-signpass secret] [-x] | -list
commands.description: compile the native application for one platform

commands.name: route:list
commands.description: list the registered routes, by module

commands.name: db:seed
commands.description: run the seeders in database/seeders (DatabaseSeeder by default)

commands.name: vendor:publish
commands.description: show what the registered modules would publish into the project, and write it

commands.name: skills:sync
commands.description: show how the project's skills differ from the skeleton's and its modules', and bring them in step

commands.name: dev
commands.usage: aru dev [-- flags for the application]
commands.description: build the views, run the application, and restart it on every change

commands.name: lsp
commands.description: serve Kyse diagnostics and completion, the project map and its navigation to an editor

commands.name: model:build
commands.description: write the query beside every entity, and refresh the factories it keeps

commands.name: view:build
commands.description: compile templates, CSS and JavaScript bundles without Node or npm

commands.name: font:add
commands.usage:
aru font:add "Young Serif" --as display [--weight 400..700] [--subset latin,latin-ext]
       aru font:add --file ./Arandu.woff2 --family "Arandu" --as display [--metrics-from ./Arandu.ttf]
commands.description: vendor a font into the project, from the catalogue or from a file of your own

commands.name: font:search
commands.description: browse the catalogue: what exists, its weights and its licence

commands.name: font:info
commands.description: one family in full: weights, axes, scripts, who drew it

commands.name: font:list
commands.description: show the vendored faces, their licences and what they weigh

commands.name: font:remove
commands.description: drop a vendored face and fall back to the system stack

commands.name: new
commands.description: create a new project from the skeleton

commands.name: make:module
commands.description: generate a full module: Model-backed entity, policy, service, request, controller, migration, screens, tests

commands.name: generate
commands.description: generate a module from a specification; the model writes the spec, never the Go

commands.name: schema
commands.description: print the JSON Schema a specification is written against

commands.name: make:model
commands.description: generate the entity, and the migration, factory, seeder, policy and request the flags ask for

commands.name: make:service
commands.description: generate the service of an existing entity, with one use case that validates, authorizes and persists

commands.name: make:resource
commands.description: generate the JSON Resource of an existing entity: the fields it answers with, and its collection

commands.name: make:notification
commands.description: generate a notification: the channels it travels by and the message each one sends

commands.name: make:client
commands.description: generate the client of an external system: config, interface, the client, a fake and the test

commands.name: make:mcp-tool
commands.description: generate a tool of the application's MCP server, calling a service as who is asking

commands.name: make:mcp-resource
commands.description: generate a resource of the application's MCP server, read through a service

commands.name: make:mcp-prompt
commands.description: generate a prompt of the application's MCP server

commands.name: make:migration
commands.description: generate one migration: a table, or columns added to one

commands.name: make:controller
commands.description: generate one controller, in the flat app/Http/Controllers package

commands.name: make:middleware
commands.description: generate one middleware, as the net/http signature every Go server takes

commands.name: make:request
commands.description: generate one input contract; authorization stays in the Policy

commands.name: make:factory
commands.description: generate the factory of an entity, with the fields read off its model

commands.name: make:seeder
commands.description: generate one seeder, for the registry in database/seeders

commands.name: make:job
commands.description: generate a background job: the payload it carries and the handler that runs it

commands.name: make:mail
commands.description: generate a mailable and the two views it renders, HTML and plain text

commands.name: make:command
commands.description: generate a console command, in app/Console/Commands

commands.name: make:listener
commands.description: generate an event listener, in app/Listeners

commands.name: make:event
commands.description: generate a domain event, stored in the outbox by the write that caused it

commands.name: make:enum
commands.description: generate a closed set of values, with the Scan/Value pair the column needs

commands.name: make:policy
commands.description: generate a policy for an existing entity

commands.name: make:test
commands.description: generate the unit test of an existing entity, in tests/Unit

commands.name: trace
commands.description: reconstruct a request in the terminal, from the running application

commands.name: action:list
commands.description: list the actions the source declares, with the constant and the line of each

commands.name: imports:catalog
commands.description: print the import path each exported framework symbol should be named by

commands.name: about
commands.description: report what the project is configured and wired with: versions, drivers, modules

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: check that the project honors the framework contracts
